summary: Run-ledger stage summaries must use the nonblocking disposition vocabulary expected by require-stage-evidence; descriptive dispositions can leave a complete stage blocking even when spawn and summary rows exist.
evidence: During the stale proposal route repair campaign, all staged subagents had recorded summaries, but require-stage-evidence rejected dispositions such as approved_scoped_repair, plan_approved, implemented_with_tests, and approved_no_replay_optional_hardening_applied. Re-recording the latest summaries with summary_status complete and summary_disposition approved made all four stage evidence checks pass.
recommended_action: Teach autonomous-auto closeout/stage-summary guidance to keep detailed judgment in role notes or external summaries while recording ledger summary_disposition as an allowed nonblocking value such as approved, pass, complete, or accepted.
